name: Campingplatz Jugendherberge Possenhofen
beschreibung: The campsite Jugendherberge Possenhofen is situated in a valley setting in Tirol, surrounded by mountains and nature. The site combines a youth hostel with pitches for tents and caravans. In the surrounding area, there are hiking trails for different ability levels. In the winter months, several ski areas in the region are reachable. The sanitary facilities are shared with the guests of the hostel. A common room is available for use in any weather. The location is suitable for activities in nature in summer and for winter sports excursions.
